title: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
abstract: arXiv:2610.00531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-generated content, often called AI slop, is increasingly common everywhere, particularly in academia. Slop in AI-generated scientific papers, however, has more complex patterns that cannot be easily detected by existing token-based AI detectors. Each part of such a paper looks plausible while the scientific reasoning that connects the parts breaks down, which can mislead how readers assess the work. We benchmark these failures as scientific slop through six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts. We construct SciSlopBench with 390 AI-generated papers, mostly in computer science but spanning the life, social, and natural sciences, each paired with a human-written paper matched by research problem and contribution type. Our measures identify the AI paper in each pair with 85.9% accuracy, compared with 68.7% for Binoculars. Higher scientific slop accompanies lower ICLR ratings and distinguishes rejected from accepted papers a

translated_title: 科学还是垃圾内容？AI生成论文中“科学垃圾”的基准评测与缓解
translated_abstract: AI生成的内容（通常被称为“AI垃圾”/AI slop）如今无处不在，在学术界尤为常见。然而，AI生成的科学论文中的垃圾内容呈现出更复杂的模式，现有的基于词元的AI检测器难以轻易识别。这类论文的每个部分看起来都合理，但连接各部分之间的科学推理却是断裂的，这会误导读者对该工作的评估。我们通过涵盖结构、论证和产出三个维度的六项指标，将这些失败模式定义为“科学垃圾”并进行基准评测。我们构建了SciSlopBench，其中包含390篇AI生成的论文，主要来自计算机科学领域，但也涵盖生命科学、社会科学和自然科学，每篇AI论文都与一篇在研究问题和贡献类型上相匹配的人类撰写论文配对。我们的指标在每对论文中识别出AI论文的准确率达到85.9%，而Binoculars的准确率仅为68.7%。科学垃圾程度越高，对应的ICLR评分越低，并且能够区分被拒稿与被接收的论文。
tldr: 该研究提出“科学垃圾”概念并构建SciSlopBench基准，通过结构、论证和产出三个维度的六项指标，以85.9%的准确率识别AI生成的科学论文，显著优于现有检测器，且垃圾程度与论文评审评分和录用结果密切相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "scientific slop" and builds SciSlopBench with 390 paired AI-generated and human-written papers, using six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts to identify AI papers with 85.9% accuracy, outperforming Binoculars (68.7%), with higher slop correlating with lower ICLR ratings.
